title_zh: 单细胞乙型肝炎测序揭示了与重复感染一致的独特病毒感染事件。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: The high error rate of the hepatitis B virus (HBV) polymerase leads to a genetically diverse quasispecies in individuals with chronic hepatitis B. Data regarding the propagation of these variants in individual hepatocytes may provide insight into viral replication and diversity of covalently closed circular DNA (cccDNA), which is the template for HBV replication. METHODS: We developed sequencing protocols to characterize HBV diversity between and within hepatocytes using RNA extracted from individually isolated hepatocytes. We sequenced HBV in >200 hepatocytes in 4 liver biopsies from people with HIV/HBV (HB1, HB2, HB3, HB6). RESULTS: We found that 2 biopsies (HB1 and HB6) showed HBV diversity between hepatocytes that met an experimentally identified threshold. Specifically, in HB1, HBV sequences from 86 individual cells were from 2 different haplotypes of genotype D: 70.2% of cells with haplotype a, 5.8% with haplotype b, and 24% with both haplotypes in the same cell. Furthermore, within single hepatocytes, up to 3 different HBV sequences were present per cell, including some cells with both genotypes A and D. HB6, who received years of lamivudine monotherapy, had evidence of drug resistance mutations distributed among hepatocytes and demonstrated up to 3 different sequences, including wild-type and drug-resistant sequences, in the same hepatocyte. Modeling of infected hepatocytes did not reveal evidence of local HBV spread based on spatial proximity. CONCLUSIONS: Taken together, our findings demonstrate that individual hepatocytes may harbor multiple, transcriptionally active HBV cccDNA molecules, which likely arose from distinct infection events.

title: Virologic Response to Antiviral Therapy in Chronic Hepatitis B Patients With High Viral Load: A Real-World Cohort Study.
abstract: Current guidelines for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) have progressively expanded antiviral treatment indications, with age > 30 years increasingly being incorporated as an important criterion. However, real-world evidence regarding treatment outcomes in this expanded population remains limited. This study evaluated the 48-week treatment response and its independent predictors in treatment-naïve CHB patients aged > 30 years with a high baseline viral load. This retrospective study included 808 treatment-naïve CHB patients aged > 30 years with baseline HBV DNA ≥ 2000 IU/mL who received first-line nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) monotherapy. Patients were classified into moderately high (MH; ≥ 2 × 10 3 to 7 IU/mL) and extremely high (EH; ≥ 1 × 10 7 IU/mL) viral load groups. Propensity score matching (PSM) and inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) were applied to adjust for baseline imbalance. At week 48, the overall virological response (VR) rate was 90.0% (727/808). Among HBeAg-positive patients at baseline, the HBeAg seroclearance and seroconversion rates were 14.0% (59/422) and 11.8% (50/422), respectively. Compared with the MH group, the EH group had significantly lower rates of VR (81.8% vs. 95.5%, p 7 IU/mL were independently associated with a lower likelihood of VR. These associations remained robust after PSM and IPTW adjustment. First-line NA therapy achieved a favourable 48-week VR in CHB patients aged > 30 years with a high viral load. However, HBeAg positivity and extremely high viral load were associated with suboptimal response, supporting intensified monitoring and individualised management.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 目前的 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 指南已逐步扩大了 抗病毒药物 治疗 的适应症,年龄 > 30 岁越来越多地被纳入一个重要标准。该研究旨在评估年龄 > 30 岁且基线病毒载量较高的 治疗 初治 CHB 患者的 48 周 治疗 反应及其独立预测因子。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项回顾性研究纳入了 808 名年龄 > 30 岁且基线 HBV DNA ≥ 2000 IU/mL 且接受一线核苷类似物 (NA) 单药治疗的 808 名 治疗 初治 CHB 患者。患者被分为中高病毒载量组(MH;≥ 2 × 10 3 至 7 IU/mL)和极高病毒载量组(EH;≥ 1 × 10 7 IU/mL)。
elements_zh.methods: 应用倾向得分匹配 (PSM) 和 治疗 加权逆概率 (IPTW) 来调整基线不平衡。该研究评估了第 48 周时的病毒学应答 (VR) 率,并确定了 VR 的独立预测因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 第 48 周时,总体病毒学应答 (VR) 率为 90.0% (727/808)。与 MH 组相比,EH 组的 VR 发生率显着较低(HBeAg 阳性率为 81.8%),并且极高的病毒载量与 VR 可能性较低独立相关。

title: Differential Hepatitis B Surface Antigen Glycan Isomer Kinetics Between Tenofovir Alafenamide and Entecavir: Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk Stratification in Hepatitis B e Antigen-Positive Patients.
abstract: Nucleos(t)ide analog (NA) therapy suppresses hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA, but residual hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk persists. O-glycosylated hepatitis B surface antigen glycan isomer (HBsAgGi) uniquely reflects virion burden. We evaluated the impact of tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) versus entecavir (ETV) on 48-week HBsAgGi kinetics and its utility in stratifying HCC risk in 90 NA-naïve patients (ETV: 73; TAF: 17). A favourable response was defined as a reduction or maintenance of low HBsAgGi levels. TAF independently predicted a favourable response compared with ETV (penalised odds ratio 3.60, p = 0.030). A significant interaction occurred between HBeAg status and HBsAgGi response in relation to HCC development (p = 0.038). In HBeAg-positive patients, a poor response was associated with increased HCC risk (hazard ratio 7.34, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.96-20.35, p = 0.001); however, the exact magnitude warrants cautious interpretation due to wide CIs. This association was absent in HBeAg-negative cases. Adding HBsAgGi response to the aMAP score improved long-term HCC prediction exclusively in the HBeAg-positive cohort. As the assay targets genotype C-specific O-glycosylation, the findings cannot be generalised to genotypes A, B, or D. In conclusion, on-treatment HBsAgGi response is a specific surrogate marker for stratifying residual HCC risk in HBeAg-positive patients, and TAF is more effective than ETV in inducing these favourable kinetics.

title: Coverage and determinants of hepatitis B virus vaccine uptake among children aged 12-36 months in Ethiopia: an analysis of the 2016 Ethiopian Demographic and Health Survey.
abstract: BACKGROUND: In Ethiopia, chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) prevalence is high (∼6%) and infant vaccination targets are unmet. We assessed HBV vaccination uptake and associations with parental sociodemographic and obstetric factors among children (aged 12-36 months) in Ethiopia. METHODS: We utilised the 2016 Ethiopian Demographic and Health Survey. We included a weighted sample of 3,855 children (aged 12-36 month) to assess HBV vaccination coverage level (none, incomplete, and complete) and its spatial distribution. Additionally, we identified associated factors of HBV vaccination coverage level using ordinal logistic regression. RESULTS: Overall, 51.2% of children received complete HBV vaccination, with wide regional variation. Older maternal age (adjusted odds ratio (AOR)=1.05, 95% confidence interval (CI): 1.02-1.07), better maternal education level (mean AOR=1.66-2.08), higher household wealth quantile (mean AOR=1.51-2.32), distance to a healthcare facility not a big problem (AOR=1.54, 95% CI: 1.25-1.89), and complete maternal continuum care utilisation (AOR=2.59, 95% CI: 1.25-5.30) were positively associated with HBV vaccination coverage, while higher number of children in the household (AOR=0.86, 95% CI: 0.79-0.92) was negatively associated. CONCLUSIONS: HBV vaccination coverage falls below World Health Organization (WHO) targets in Ethiopia and has substantial regional variation. Targeted vaccination campaigns for mothers in lower socioeconomic groups and larger families may improve vaccination coverage.

title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚 12-36 个月龄儿童 乙型肝炎病毒 疫苗 的覆盖范围和决定因素:对 2016 年埃塞俄比亚人口和健康调查的分析。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: In Ethiopia, chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) prevalence is high (∼6%) and infant vaccination targets are unmet. We assessed HBV vaccination uptake and associations with parental sociodemographic and obstetric factors among children (aged 12-36 months) in Ethiopia. METHODS: We utilised the 2016 Ethiopian Demographic and Health Survey. We included a weighted sample of 3,855 children (aged 12-36 month) to assess HBV vaccination coverage level (none, incomplete, and complete) and its spatial distribution. Additionally, we identified associated factors of HBV vaccination coverage level using ordinal logistic regression. RESULTS: Overall, 51.2% of children received complete HBV vaccination, with wide regional variation. Older maternal age (adjusted odds ratio (AOR)=1.05, 95% confidence interval (CI): 1.02-1.07), better maternal education level (mean AOR=1.66-2.08), higher household wealth quantile (mean AOR=1.51-2.32), distance to a healthcare facility not a big problem (AOR=1.54, 95% CI: 1.25-1.89), and complete maternal continuum care utilisation (AOR=2.59, 95% CI: 1.25-5.30) were positively associated with HBV vaccination coverage, while higher number of children in the household (AOR=0.86, 95% CI: 0.79-0.92) was negatively associated. CONCLUSIONS: HBV vaccination coverage falls below World Health Organization (WHO) targets in Ethiopia and has substantial regional variation. Targeted vaccination campaigns for mothers in lower socioeconomic groups and larger families may improve vaccination coverage.

title: Awareness, knowledge, acceptance, and uptake of hepatitis B vaccines among healthcare workers in Nigeria: a scoping review
abstract: Hepatitis B vaccines have been licensed for public use since the 20th century; however, many health workers in Nigeria are yet to recognise the importance of this notable scientific discovery. This scoping review aimed to assess the awareness, knowledge, acceptance, and uptake of hepatitis B vaccines among healthcare workers in Nigeria. The scoping review was reported using the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR) guidelines. Relevant peer-reviewed studies published from January 2021 to September 2025 were searched from five public databases using Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) terms, keywords, truncations and Boolean operators. The Population, Concept, Context (PCC) framework was used to design the inclusion criteria. Relevant data were extracted from each paper, and thematic analysis was done to summarise the findings. Twenty-two studies with a total sample size of 5,537 and all cross-sectional designs were included in the review. The studies were mainly from Southern Nigeria. The awareness of hepatitis B virus (HBV) vaccines among healthcare workers (HCWs) was described in nine studies and it ranged from 50.7% in Abuja to 100% in Kaduna State. The uptake of at least one dose of the vaccine was an outcome in sixteen studies and it ranged from 19.9% in Anambra State to 80% in Sokoto State. There was insufficient evidence on the knowledge and acceptance of HBV vaccines among HCWs in Nigeria, as only two studies reported on each theme. In conclusion, many healthcare workers in Nigeria were aware of effective vaccines for HBV, however, the uptake of these vaccines remained unsatisfactory in some regions.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines awareness, knowledge, acceptance, and uptake of hepatitis B virus (HBV) vaccines among healthcare workers (HCWs) in Nigeria, focusing on the central question of vaccine-related behaviors and determinants in this specific population and setting.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This scoping review followed PRISMA-ScR guidelines and searched five public databases from January 2021 to September 2025 using MeSH terms, keywords, truncations, and Boolean operators. Inclusion criteria were designed using the Population, Concept, Context (PCC) framework, and thematic analysis was performed to summarize findings from 22 cross-sectional studies with a total sample size of 5,537 HCWs.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review reports high variability in HBV vaccine awareness among HCWs in Nigeria, ranging from 50.7% to 100% across states, and unsatisfactory vaccine uptake in some regions, with rates as low as 19.9% and as high as 80%. It concludes that while awareness of HBV vaccines is present, uptake remains suboptimal in certain areas.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The evidence base shows insufficient data on knowledge and acceptance of HBV vaccines among HCWs in Nigeria, with only two studies reporting on each theme. Additionally, the review highlights a geographic imbalance, as most included studies were from Southern Nigeria, leaving substantial regional gaps in evidence.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review underscores the need for targeted interventions to improve HBV vaccine uptake among HCWs in Nigeria, particularly in regions with low uptake, and calls for further research to address critical gaps in knowledge and acceptance assessments.

analysis.summary_en: This scoping review assesses awareness, knowledge, acceptance, and uptake of hepatitis B virus (HBV) vaccines among healthcare workers (HCWs) in Nigeria. Using PRISMA-ScR guidelines, it synthesized data from 22 cross-sectional studies involving 5,537 HCWs, primarily from Southern Nigeria. Findings reveal high variability in vaccine awareness (50.7% to 100%) and suboptimal uptake in some regions (19.9% to 80%). However, evidence on knowledge and acceptance is sparse, with only two studies addressing each theme. The review highlights geographic imbalances in study coverage and calls for targeted interventions to improve vaccine uptake and further research to fill critical knowledge gaps.

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该评价调查了尼日利亚医护人员 (HCW) 对 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 疫苗 的认识、知识、接受度和采用情况,重点关注这一特定人群和环境中 疫苗 相关行为和决定因素的核心问题。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 此次范围界定审查遵循 PRISMA-ScR 指南,并使用 MeSH 术语、关键词、截断和布尔运算符搜索了 2021 年 1 月至 2025 年 9 月的五个公共数据库。纳入标准是使用人口、概念、背景 (PCC) 框架设计的,并进行了主题分析,总结了 22 项横断面研究的结果,总样本量为 5,537 名医护人员。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该审查报告称,尼日利亚医护人员对 HBV 疫苗 的认知存在很大差异,各州的认知度从 50.7% 到 100% 不等,而某些地区的 疫苗 知晓率并不令人满意,比率低至 19.9%,高至 80%。结论是,虽然存在对 HBV 疫苗 的认识,但某些地区的吸收率仍然不理想。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 证据基础显示,尼日利亚医护人员对 HBV 疫苗 的了解和接受程度的数据不足,只有两项研究报告了每个主题。此外,该审查强调了地理不平衡,因为大多数纳入的研究都来自尼日利亚南部,导致证据存在巨大的区域差距。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查强调需要采取有针对性的干预措施,以提高尼日利亚医护人员对 HBV 疫苗 的采用率,特别是在采用率较低的地区,并呼吁开展进一步研究,以解决知识和接受评估方面的关键差距。

title: Complex dynamics behavior in a generalized diffusive multiple delays within-host model for HBV infection with capsids and adaptive immune response in a heterogeneous viral environment
abstract: Abstract In this paper, we investigate the dynamics of a new chronic hepatitis B model through environmental-driven infection in heterogeneous and homogenous space. The model includes spatial diffusion, five time delays, and a general incidence function. The well-posedness of solutions, including the existence of global solutions, uniqueness, non-negativity, ultimate boundedness, is established. The reproduction numbers for virus infection, CTL immune response, antibody immune response, CTL immune competition and antibody immune competition, respectively, are calculated. By employing the Lyapunov functionals and linearization methods, the threshold conditions on the global stability of the infection-free equilibrium are obtained; and the threshold conditions on the uniform persistence and the global stability of the equilibria for immune-free, antibody response, CTL response and antibody and CTL responses, respectively, are established. The occurrence of Hopf bifurcation of the spatially homogeneous equilibria is also established. An application is provided, and numerical simulations are carried out to illustrate the analytical results and verify the conjectures. Our findings reveal the rich and complex patterns of HBV infection dynamics in vivo, including regular and irregular periodic oscillations. Irregular oscillations may signify immune disorders and allergies. Also, from numerical simulations, it follows that the majority of hepatitis B infection could escape chronic infection.
journal: Mathematical Medicine and Biology: A Journal of the IMA

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide insights into the dynamics of HBV infection and may inform future studies on immune responses and the development of therapeutic strategies for managing HBV infection.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a mathematical model and numerical simulations, which may not fully capture the complexities of real-world HBV infection dynamics. The evidence is moderate as it is derived from theoretical analysis and simulations.

The findings reveal complex patterns of HBV infection dynamics in vivo, including regular and irregular periodic oscillations, which may indicate immune disorders and allergies. The study's results may inform future research on immune responses and therapeutic strategies for HBV. However, the evidence is based on theoretical analysis and simulations, which may not fully represent real-world scenarios, limiting the confidence in the findings to a moderate level.

title_zh: 异质病毒环境中衣壳和适应性 免疫应答 HBV 感染的 宿主 模型内广义扩散多重延迟中的复杂动力学行为
source_body_en: Abstract In this paper, we investigate the dynamics of a new chronic hepatitis B model through environmental-driven infection in heterogeneous and homogenous space. The model includes spatial diffusion, five time delays, and a general incidence function. The well-posedness of solutions, including the existence of global solutions, uniqueness, non-negativity, ultimate boundedness, is established. The reproduction numbers for virus infection, CTL immune response, antibody immune response, CTL immune competition and antibody immune competition, respectively, are calculated. By employing the Lyapunov functionals and linearization methods, the threshold conditions on the global stability of the infection-free equilibrium are obtained; and the threshold conditions on the uniform persistence and the global stability of the equilibria for immune-free, antibody response, CTL response and antibody and CTL responses, respectively, are established. The occurrence of Hopf bifurcation of the spatially homogeneous equilibria is also established. An application is provided, and numerical simulations are carried out to illustrate the analytical results and verify the conjectures. Our findings reveal the rich and complex patterns of HBV infection dynamics in vivo, including regular and irregular periodic oscillations. Irregular oscillations may signify immune disorders and allergies. Also, from numerical simulations, it follows that the majority of hepatitis B infection could escape chronic infection.

title: Mixed Cryoglobulinaemic Glomerulonephritis Section Type II in the Setting of Rheumatoid Arthritis and Chronic Hepatitis B: A Case Report
abstract: Mixed (Type II) cryoglobulinaemia is a systemic immune-complex vasculitis often linked to chronic infections especially Hepatitis C Virus (HCV) or autoimmune disease. Chronic Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) associated cryoglobulinaemic is rare, and its coexistence with Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) is especially unusual. The authors report a 45-year-old female with long-standing seropositive RA on methotrexate and chronic HBV presented with fatigue, arthralgias, palpable purpura on her legs, and new-onset oedema. Laboratory workup showed elevated serum creatinine, nephrotic-range proteinuria, hypoalbuminaemia, haematuria, and a positive Rheumatoid Factor (RF). Antinuclear Antibody (ANA) and Anti-double-stranded deoxyribonucleic acid (anti-dsDNA) were negative. Complement levels i.e., Component 3 (C3) moderately reduced, Component 4 (C4) severely low, and positive mixed cryoglobulins with a high Immunoglobulin M (IgM) cryocrit. HCV and Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) serologies were negative. Renal biopsy showed a diffuse endocapillary proliferative, Membranoproliferative Glomerulonephritis (MPGN) with hyaline “pseudothrombi.” Immunofluorescence disclosed granular capillary wall deposits of IgM, Immunoglobulin G (IgG) (both kappa and lambda), C3, and C1q, consistent with Type II cryoglobulinaemic GN. Treatment included high-dose corticosteroids and HBV antiviral drugs. Despite antiviral therapy and plasmapheresis, renal failure progressed requiring haemodialysis, and the patient died within three weeks due to disease-related complications and nosocomial infection. The present case highlights that RA and HBV can together underlie cryoglobulinaemic GN. Early recognition using RF, complement, and cryocrit testing and biopsy-guided therapy are critical. Purpura, positive RF, and low C4/C3 should prompt consideration of mixed cryoglobulinaemic vasculitis.
journal: JOURNAL OF CLINICAL AND DIAGNOSTIC RESEARCH

analysis.research_question_and_background: Mixed cryoglobulinaemic glomerulonephritis (GN) is a systemic immune-complex vasculitis often associated with chronic infections like Hepatitis C Virus (HCV) or autoimmune diseases, but its occurrence in the context of Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) and Chronic Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) is rare and unusual.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This case report describes a 45-year-old female with seropositive RA on methotrexate and chronic HBV who presented with fatigue, arthralgias, palpable purpura, and new-onset oedema. The study focuses on the clinical presentation and diagnostic findings of this unique case.
analysis.methods: The patient underwent laboratory workup, including serological testing for HCV and HIV, and a renal biopsy to assess the histopathological features of the glomerulonephritis. Immunofluorescence was used to identify immune complex deposits.
analysis.main_results: Laboratory tests revealed elevated serum creatinine, nephrotic-range proteinuria, hypoalbuminaemia, haematuria, and a positive Rheumatoid Factor (RF). Complement levels were moderately reduced (Component 3) and severely low (Component 4), with positive mixed cryoglobulins and a high Immunoglobulin M (IgM) cryocrit. Renal biopsy showed diffuse endocapillary proliferative, membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis (MPGN) with hyaline pseudothrombi, and immunofluorescence confirmed granular capillary wall deposits of IgM, IgG (both kappa and lambda), C3, and C1q.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The case highlights that RA and HBV can coexist and contribute to the development of mixed cryoglobulinaemic GN, which is a rare and unusual association. The findings suggest the importance of considering this condition in patients with overlapping autoimmune and viral diseases.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The case underscores the need for early recognition of mixed cryoglobulinaemic vasculitis in patients with RA and HBV, emphasizing the role of RF, complement, and cryocrit testing, as well as biopsy-guided therapy, in managing such complex clinical scenarios.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: As a case report, the study lacks the statistical power and control groups to establish causality or generalize findings. The evidence is limited to a single patient case, which provides a descriptive insight but does not support broader conclusions.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a 45-year-old female with seropositive rheumatoid arthritis (RA) on methotrexate and chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection who developed mixed cryoglobulinaemic glomerulonephritis (GN). Laboratory findings included elevated serum creatinine, nephrotic-range proteinuria, hypoalbuminaemia, haematuria, and a positive rheumatoid factor (RF), with complement levels showing moderate reduction (C3) and severe reduction (C4). Renal biopsy confirmed diffuse endocapillary proliferative, membranoproliferative GN with hyaline pseudothrombi, and immunofluorescence revealed granular deposits of IgM, IgG, C3, and C1q. Despite treatment with antiviral therapy and plasmapheresis, the patient's renal failure progressed, requiring haemodialysis, and she died within three weeks due to complications. The case highlights the rare coexistence of RA and HBV in causing mixed cryoglobulinaemic GN and emphasizes the importance of early diagnosis through RF, complement, and cryocrit testing, along with biopsy-guided therapy. However, the study's limitations include its single-case design, which restricts generalizability and causal inference.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 混合性冷球蛋白血症性肾小球肾炎 (GN) 是一种全身性免疫复合物血管炎,通常与丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 等慢性感染或自身免疫性疾病相关,但其在类风湿关节炎 (RA) 和 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 背景下的发生罕见且不常见。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 病例报告 描述了一名 45 岁女性,患有甲氨蝶呤血清阳性 RA 和慢性乙型肝炎,表现为疲劳、关节痛、可触及的紫癜和新发水肿。该研究重点关注这一独特病例的临床表现和诊断结果。
elements_zh.methods: 该患者接受了实验室检查,包括 HCV 和 HIV 血清学检测,以及肾活检以评估肾小球肾炎的组织病理学特征。免疫荧光用于识别免疫复合物沉积物。
elements_zh.main_results: 实验室检查显示血清肌酐升高、肾病范围蛋白尿、低蛋白血症、血尿和类风湿因子 (RF) 阳性。补体水平中度降低(成分 3)和严重降低(成分 4),混合冷球蛋白呈阳性,免疫球蛋白 M (IgM) 冷容比较高。肾活检显示弥漫性毛细血管内增殖性、膜增殖性肾小球肾炎 (MPGN) 伴透明假血栓,免疫荧光证实 IgM、IgG(κ 和 lambda)、C3 和 C1q 颗粒状毛细血管壁沉积。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该病例强调 RA 和 HBV 可以共存并促进混合性冷球蛋白血症 GN 的发展,这是一种罕见且不寻常的关联。研究结果表明,对于患有重叠的自身免疫性疾病和病毒性疾病的患者,考虑这种情况的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该病例强调了早期识别 RA 和 HBV 患者混合性冷球蛋白血管炎的必要性,强调了 RF、补体和冷比容测试以及活检引导治疗在管理此类复杂临床情况中的作用。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 作为一项 病例报告,该研究缺乏统计能力和对照组来建立因果关系或概括结果。证据仅限于单个患者病例,它提供了描述性见解,但不支持更广泛的结论。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该病例强调了早期识别 RA 和 HBV 患者混合性冷球蛋白血管炎的必要性,强调了 RF、补体和冷比容测试以及活检引导治疗在管理此类复杂临床情况中的作用。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 作为一项 病例报告,该研究缺乏统计能力和对照组来建立因果关系或概括结果。证据仅限于单个患者病例,它提供了描述性见解,但不支持更广泛的结论。

title: Genomic and transcriptomic features of HBV integration in treatment-naïve, HBeAg-positive children with chronic HBV infection
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) integration represents a major obstacle to curing HBV; however, the landscape of HBV integration and local immune response to transcriptionally active viral integration in children with chronic HBV infection remain unclear. Herein, we aimed to elucidate this landscape in this population. METHODS: Genomic analyses using a probe-based capture strategy were performed on 18 children and 28 adults with chronic HBV infection. Spatial transcriptomics (ST) was performed on 12 children from our cohort and 3 adults from a public database. FINDINGS: All patients were hepatitis B e antigen (HBeAg)-positive and treatment-naïve. Genomically, children exhibited significantly lower clonal expansion level of HBV-integrated hepatocytes than adults, despite comparable unique breakpoint counts. After adjusting for confounding variables, age was identified as an independent risk factor for total frequency of unique integration breakpoints (b = 3.22, P = 0.005). Spatially, ST revealed that spots with transcriptionally active viral integration exhibited a sparse distribution and accounted for a low proportion of all spots in children. Notably, at these spots, children showed reduced adaptive immune cells (e.g., CD8+ T cells) but increased innate components (myeloid cells, Kupffer cells, activated dendritic cells) and APC co-stimulation, whereas adults exhibited a uniform reduction of immune cell populations. INTERPRETATION: Compared with adults, children exhibit lower clonal expansion of HBV-integrated hepatocytes and distinct immune profiles in response to transcriptionally active viral integration, offering new insights into their differing clinical course. FUNDING: Key Laboratory of Molecular Biology for Infectious Diseases (Ministry of Education).

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in children poses unique challenges for cure, yet the landscape of HBV integration and local immune responses to transcriptionally active viral integration in this population remains poorly understood.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study performed genomic analyses using a probe-based capture strategy on 18 children and 28 adults with chronic HBV infection, and spatial transcriptomics on 12 children from the cohort and 3 adults from a public database.
analysis.methods: Genomic analyses were conducted using a probe-based capture strategy, and spatial transcriptomics was performed to assess transcriptional activity and immune cell profiles.
analysis.main_results: Children exhibited significantly lower clonal expansion of HBV-integrated hepatocytes than adults despite comparable unique breakpoint counts, and transcriptionally active viral integration spots were sparsely distributed and accounted for a low proportion of all spots in children.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Children showed reduced adaptive immune cells but increased innate components and APC co-stimulation at transcriptionally active integration spots, contrasting with adults who exhibited uniform reduction of immune cell populations, offering new insights into age-related differences in HBV integration and immune response.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight age-dependent differences in HBV integration and immune microenvironment, which may inform strategies for monitoring and treating chronic HBV infection in children.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Age was identified as an independent risk factor for total frequency of unique integration breakpoints, indicating potential confounding and limiting generalisability beyond the studied cohort.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated HBV integration and local immune responses in treatment-naïve, HBeAg-positive children with chronic HBV infection compared to adults. Using genomic and spatial transcriptomic analyses, researchers found that children had significantly lower clonal expansion of HBV-integrated hepatocytes than adults despite similar numbers of unique integration breakpoints. Spatially, transcriptionally active viral integration was sparsely distributed in children, where adaptive immune cells were reduced while innate components and antigen-presenting cell co-stimulation were increased. Adults showed a uniform reduction in immune cell populations. These age-dependent differences in HBV integration and immune microenvironment provide new insights into the distinct clinical course of chronic HBV infection in children and may guide future surveillance and therapeutic strategies.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 儿童中的 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 感染对治疗提出了独特的挑战,但该人群中 HBV 整合和局部 免疫应答 与转录活性病毒整合的情况仍知之甚少。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用基于探针的捕获策略对 18 名患有慢性 HBV 感染的儿童和 28 名成人进行基因组分析,并对来自 队列研究 的 12 名儿童和来自公共数据库的 3 名成人进行空间转录组学。
elements_zh.methods: 使用基于探针的捕获策略进行基因组分析,并进行空间转录组学以评估转录活性和免疫细胞概况。
elements_zh.main_results: 尽管独特的断点数量相当,但儿童的 HBV 整合肝细胞克隆扩增明显低于成人,而且转录活性病毒整合点分布稀疏,占儿童所有点的比例较低。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 儿童表现出适应性免疫细胞减少,但转录活性整合位点的先天成分和 APC 共刺激增加,与表现出免疫细胞群均匀减少的成年人形成鲜明对比,这为 HBV 整合和 免疫应答 中与年龄相关的差异提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了乙型肝炎病毒整合和免疫微环境的年龄依赖性差异,这可能为监测和治疗儿童慢性乙型肝炎病毒感染的策略提供参考。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 年龄被确定为独特积分断点总频率的独立风险因素,表明超出研究的 队列研究 的潜在混淆和限制普遍性。

Spatially, ST revealed that spots with transcriptionally active viral integration exhibited a sparse distribution and accounted for a low proportion of all spots in children. Notably, at these spots, children showed reduced adaptive immune cells (e.g., CD8+ T cells) but increased innate components (myeloid cells, Kupffer cells, activated dendritic cells) and APC co-stimulation, whereas adults exhibited a uniform reduction of immune cell populations. INTERPRETATION: Compared with adults, children exhibit lower clonal expansion of HBV-integrated hepatocytes and distinct immune profiles in response to transcriptionally active viral integration, offering new insights into their differing clinical course. title: A New Nomogram for Mortality Prediction Within 5 Years in Portal Vein Thrombosis due to Hepatitis B-Related Cirrhosis.
abstract: This study aims to develop a nomogram model intended for predicting long-term mortality in patients suffering from hepatitis B-related cirrhosis associated with Portal vein thrombosis (PVT). A total of 961 patients were recruited from January 2015 to December 2023, forming the training cohort. We analysed independent risk factors affecting 5-year mortality through COX regression, from which we constructed a nomogram. To assess the nomogram's utility, we employed the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve, C-index, calibration curves, and decision curve analysis (DCA). The independent prognostic factors retained in the final model for patients with hepatitis B-related cirrhosis complicated by PVT included age (HR = 1.09, 95% CI: 1.06-1.11; p < 0.001), leukocyte count (WBC) (HR = 1.09, 95% CI: 1.03-1.17; p = 0.002), and the neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) (HR = 1.29, 95% CI: 1.22-1.35; p < 0.001), along with serum sodium (HR = 0.94, 95% CI: 0.90-0.98; p = 0.005). The AUROC values for the nomogram were 0.906 (95% CI: 0.891-0.921) in the training cohort and 0.910 (95% CI: 0.885-0.927) in the validation cohort, demonstrating improved performance and discriminatory ability compared to current models, including CTP and MELD scores. Age, leukocyte count (WBC), NLR, and serum sodium emerged as independent risk factors impacting prognosis for patients with hepatitis B cirrhosis and PVT within 5 years. The nomogram developed in this research holds significant potential for accurately predicting the outcomes of these patients within 5 years.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the unmet need for accurate long-term mortality prediction in patients with hepatitis B-related cirrhosis complicated by portal vein thrombosis (PVT), a high-risk subgroup with limited prognostic tools.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective cohort of 961 patients with hepatitis B-related cirrhosis and PVT was recruited from January 2015 to December 2023 and formed the training cohort for model development.
analysis.methods: Independent risk factors for 5-year mortality were identified using Cox regression, and a nomogram was constructed from these factors; model performance was assessed with ROC curves, C-index, calibration curves, and decision curve analysis.
analysis.main_results: The nomogram achieved AUROC values of 0.906 (95% CI: 0.891–0.921) in the training cohort and 0.910 (95% CI: 0.885–0.927) in the validation cohort, outperforming Child–Turcotte–Pugh and MELD scores.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the nomogram as a significant advance in individualized risk stratification for this patient group, highlighting its improved discrimination compared to existing scoring systems.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The nomogram could inform clinical decision-making by enabling earlier identification of high-risk patients for intensified monitoring or therapeutic interventions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The single-centre, retrospective design and lack of external validation limit generalisability; the evidence strength is assessed as moderate due to potential selection and confounding biases.

analysis.summary_en: This study developed a nomogram to predict 5-year mortality in patients with hepatitis B-related cirrhosis complicated by portal vein thrombosis (PVT) using a training cohort of 961 patients. Independent prognostic factors included age, leukocyte count, neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio, and serum sodium. The model demonstrated high discriminatory performance with AUROC values of 0.906 in training and 0.910 in validation, outperforming Child–Turcotte–Pugh and MELD scores. The authors propose the nomogram as a clinically useful tool for individualized risk stratification in this high-risk subgroup.

analysis_zh.main_results: 该列线图在训练 队列研究 中实现了 0.906 (95% CI: 0.891–0.921) 的 AUROC 值,在验证 队列研究 中实现了 0.910 (95% CI: 0.885–0.927) 的 AUROC 值,优于 Child–Turcotte–Pugh 和 MELD 评分。

title: Validation of a Point-Of-Care Ultrasound for Hepatitis Among Front-Line Healthcare Workers Managing Chronic Hepatitis B Virus Infection in Zambia.
abstract: To close gaps in implementing care of people with hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in resource-limited settings, we evaluated the accuracy of a novel liver point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) protocol for hepatitis (PUSH) among front-line non-radiology healthcare workers in Zambia. At University Teaching Hospital in Lusaka, Zambia, from March to June 2024, we trained four nurses and six physicians with experience in HBV management, but not in ultrasound (US), in the PUSH protocol, which includes visualizing the liver in three windows (epigastric, subcostal and right transcostal) to identify cirrhosis-suggestive features and liver lesions suspicious for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Then, consecutive adult participants with chronic hepatitis B (PWHB) alone or HBV/HIV coinfection underwent PUSH with operators blinded to clinical data. We evaluated the accuracy of PUSH for significant fibrosis and cirrhosis using transient elastography (TE) as the reference standard test (RST) and for liver lesions that were possible HCC using a comprehensive abdominal ultrasound by an experienced radiographer as the RST. Nonparametric analysis of the receiver operating curve (ROC) for PUSH was adjusted for operator type (doctor vs. nurse), sex and HIV status. Among 197 PWHBs analysed, 69.5% were taking HBV antivirals and 27.9% had HBV/HIV. According to RSTs, 17.7% of PWHBs had significant fibrosis, 11.6% had cirrhosis and 3.5% had liver lesions. PUSH had low accuracy for significant fibrosis, with sensitivity of 8.3% (17.5-41.4), specificity of 100.0% (96.1-100) and an area under the curve (AUROC) of 0.54 (0.43-0.65), moderate accuracy for cirrhosis, with sensitivity of 60.9% (38.5-80.3), specificity of 97.7% (94.2-99.4) and AUROC of 0.79 (0.69-0.89), and higher accuracy for liver lesions, with 85.7% (42.1-99.6) sensitivity, 98.4% (95.5-99.7) specificity, AUROC of 0.92 (0.78-1.00). After an expedited training, front-line nurses and physicians treating HBV in Zambia were able to use PUSH to diagnose cirrhosis with moderate accuracy and liver lesions with high accuracy, although confidence intervals around performance estimates were wide. Liver POCUS including PUSH may be useful in HBV management when laboratory systems and TE are lacking.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the need to improve hepatitis B virus (HBV) care in resource-limited settings by evaluating a novel point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) protocol (PUSH) for diagnosing HBV-related liver disease among front-line healthcare workers in Zambia.
analysis.study_design_and_population: At University Teaching Hospital in Lusaka, Zambia, from March to June 2024, four nurses and six physicians with HBV management experience but no ultrasound training were trained in the PUSH protocol, which assesses liver cirrhosis-suggestive features and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) lesions in three windows.
analysis.methods: Consecutive adult participants with chronic hepatitis B (PWHB) alone or HBV/HIV coinfection underwent PUSH with operators blinded to clinical data, and accuracy was evaluated using transient elastography (TE) as the reference standard for fibrosis and cirrhosis and comprehensive abdominal ultrasound by an experienced radiographer for liver lesions.
analysis.main_results: Among 197 PWHBs, 17.7% had significant fibrosis, 11.6% had cirrhosis, and 3.5% had liver lesions; PUSH showed low accuracy for significant fibrosis (sensitivity 8.3%, specificity 100.0%, AUROC 0.54), moderate accuracy for cirrhosis (sensitivity 60.9%, specificity 97.7%, AUROC 0.79), and high accuracy for liver lesions (sensitivity 85.7%, specificity 98.4%, AUROC 0.92).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that PUSH can diagnose cirrhosis with moderate accuracy and liver lesions with high accuracy after expedited training, highlighting its potential utility in HBV management where laboratory systems and TE are lacking.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that PUSH could support HBV care in resource-limited settings by enabling front-line healthcare workers to identify cirrhosis and HCC lesions, potentially improving early diagnosis and referral pathways.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s limitations include wide confidence intervals around performance estimates and reliance on a single-center, short-duration training, which may limit generalisability and precision of accuracy metrics.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated a point-of-care ultrasound protocol (PUSH) for diagnosing hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related liver disease among front-line healthcare workers in Zambia. After brief training, nurses and physicians used PUSH to assess liver cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) lesions in adults with chronic HBV or HBV/HIV coinfection. Using transient elastography and expert ultrasound as reference standards, PUSH showed low accuracy for significant fibrosis (AUROC 0.54), moderate accuracy for cirrhosis (AUROC 0.79), and high accuracy for liver lesions (AUROC 0.92). The authors conclude that PUSH may be useful for HBV management in settings lacking laboratory infrastructure, though confidence intervals were wide and the single-center design limits generalisability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究通过评估用于诊断赞比亚一线医护人员中 HBV 相关肝病的新型护理点超声 (POCUS) 方案 (PUSH),解决了在资源有限的环境中改善 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 护理的需要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024 年 3 月至 6 月,在赞比亚卢萨卡的大学教学医院,四名护士和六名具有乙肝管理经验但没有接受过超声培训的医生接受了 PUSH 方案培训,该方案在三个窗口中评估肝硬化提示特征和肝细胞癌 (HCC) 病变。
elements_zh.methods: 单独感染 慢性乙型肝炎 (PWHB) 或 HBV/HIV 合并感染的连续成人参与者在不了解临床数据的操作员的情况下接受 PUSH,并使用瞬时弹性成像 (TE) 作为纤维化和肝硬化的参考标准以及由经验丰富的肝脏病变放射技师进行综合腹部超声评估准确性。
elements_zh.main_results: 197名感染者中,17.7%有明显纤维化,11.6%有肝硬化,3.5%有肝脏病变;PUSH 对显着纤维化的准确性较低(敏感性 8.3%,特异性 100.0%,AUROC 0.54),对肝硬化的准确性中等(敏感性 60.9%,特异性 97.7%,AUROC 0.79),对肝脏病变的准确性较高(敏感性 85.7%,特异性 98.4%,AUROC 0.92)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,经过快速培训后,PUSH 可以以中等准确度诊断肝硬化,并以较高准确度诊断肝脏病变,这突显了其在缺乏实验室系统和 TE 的 HBV 管理中的潜在用途。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,PUSH 可以通过使一线医护人员识别肝硬化和 HCC 病变来支持资源有限环境中的 HBV 护理,从而有可能改善早期 诊断 和转诊途径。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括表现估计的置信区间较宽,以及对单中心、短期训练的依赖,这可能会限制准确性指标的普遍性和精度。

Nonparametric analysis of the receiver operating curve (ROC) for PUSH was adjusted for operator type (doctor vs. nurse), sex and HIV status. Among 197 PWHBs analysed, 69.5% were taking HBV antivirals and 27.9% had HBV/HIV. According to RSTs, 17.7% of PWHBs had significant fibrosis, 11.6% had cirrhosis and 3.5% had liver lesions. After an expedited training, front-line nurses and physicians treating HBV in Zambia were able to use PUSH to diagnose cirrhosis with moderate accuracy and liver lesions with high accuracy, although confidence intervals around performance estimates were wide. Liver POCUS including PUSH may be useful in HBV management when laboratory systems and TE are lacking.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究通过评估用于诊断赞比亚一线医护人员中 HBV 相关肝病的新型护理点超声 (POCUS) 方案 (PUSH),解决了在资源有限的环境中改善 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 护理的需要。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024 年 3 月至 6 月,在赞比亚卢萨卡的大学教学医院,四名护士和六名具有乙肝管理经验但没有接受过超声培训的医生接受了 PUSH 方案培训,该方案在三个窗口中评估肝硬化提示特征和肝细胞癌 (HCC) 病变。
analysis_zh.methods: 单独感染 慢性乙型肝炎 (PWHB) 或 HBV/HIV 合并感染的连续成人参与者在不了解临床数据的操作员的情况下接受 PUSH,并使用瞬时弹性成像 (TE) 作为纤维化和肝硬化的参考标准以及由经验丰富的肝脏病变放射技师进行综合腹部超声评估准确性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 197名感染者中,17.7%有明显纤维化,11.6%有肝硬化,3.5%有肝脏病变;PUSH 对显着纤维化的准确性较低(敏感性 8.3%,特异性 100.0%,AUROC 0.54),对肝硬化的准确性中等(敏感性 60.9%,特异性 97.7%,AUROC 0.79),对肝脏病变的准确性较高(敏感性 85.7%,特异性 98.4%,AUROC 0.92)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,经过快速培训后,PUSH 可以以中等准确度诊断肝硬化,并以较高准确度诊断肝脏病变,这突显了其在缺乏实验室系统和 TE 的 HBV 管理中的潜在用途。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,PUSH 可以通过使一线医护人员识别肝硬化和 HCC 病变来支持资源有限环境中的 HBV 护理,从而有可能改善早期 诊断 和转诊途径。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括表现估计的置信区间较宽,以及对单中心、短期训练的依赖,这可能会限制准确性指标的普遍性和精度。

title: Assessing the Status of and Impediments to Achieving the WHO Goal to Eliminate Viral Hepatitis B by 2030: A Scoping Review
abstract: This project registers a scoping review examining progress toward the World Health Organization (WHO) goal of eliminating viral hepatitis B (HBV) as a public health threat by 2030. In 2016, the WHO set targets of a 90% reduction in new chronic infections and a 65% reduction in mortality relative to a 2015 baseline; yet, despite effective vaccines and potent antivirals, viral hepatitis mortality continues to rise. The review assesses the global and regional status of, and impediments to, the 2030 HBV elimination goal, and compares HBV with hepatitis C virus (HCV) elimination trajectories. It was conducted following the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) methodology and reported in accordance with the PRISMA extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR). Peer-reviewed literature, global and regional surveillance reports, and grey literature published between 2015 and 2025 were searched across five databases and multiple institutional repositories, using the JBI Population–Concept–Context (PCC) framework. Charted data were mapped against WHO impact indicators (incidence, mortality, prevalence) and service-coverage indicators (HepB3 and timely birth-dose vaccination, diagnosis, treatment) across the six WHO regions. The specific objectives are: (i) to determine the global and regional status against the WHO 2030 HBV elimination targets; (ii) to evaluate the effectiveness, implementation, and gaps of HBV vaccination strategies (HepB3 and birth dose) and their impact on HBV epidemiology; and (iii) to compare HBV and HCV elimination efforts to identify divergent challenges and transferable opportunities.

analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Despite the availability of effective vaccines and potent antivirals, viral hepatitis mortality continues to rise. analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review identifies specific priorities for research, surveillance, diagnosis, treatment, and policy to address the ongoing challenges in achieving the WHO goal of eliminating HBV by 2030. elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该审查重点关注实现世卫组织到 2030 年消除作为公共卫生威胁的乙型病毒性肝炎 (HBV) 目标的现状和障碍。审查审查了实现这一目标的进展情况,评估了 HBV 疫苗接种 策略的有效性,并将乙型肝炎病毒消除工作与丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 消除工作进行了比较。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 范围界定审查是按照 Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) 的方法进行的,并根据 PRISMA 范围界定审查扩展 (PRISMA-ScR) 进行报告。它使用 JBI 人口-概念-背景 (PCC) 框架,在五个数据库和多个机构存储库中检索了同行评审文献、全球和区域 监测 报告以及 2015 年至 2025 年间发表的灰色文献。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 尽管有有效的 疫苗 和强效 抗病毒药物,病毒性肝炎 死亡率 的数量仍在继续上升。该审查根据世卫组织影响指标(发病率、死亡率、患病率)和服务覆盖指标(HepB3 和及时出生剂量 疫苗接种、诊断、治疗)绘制了世卫组织六个区域的数据,以评估实现 2030 年消除目标的进展情况。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该审查强调了 HBV 疫苗接种 战略及其实施方面的差距,以及实现世卫组织目标的挑战。它还指出,与丙肝病毒相比,需要对乙肝病毒的消除工作进行更详细的分析,特别是在确定不同的挑战和可转移的机会方面。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查确定了研究的具体优先事项、监测、诊断、治疗 和政策,以应对实现世卫组织到 2030 年消除乙型肝炎的目标所面临的持续挑战。其中包括提高 疫苗接种 覆盖率、增强诊断和 治疗 的可及性以及加强 监测 系统。

title_zh: 评估实现世界卫生组织 2030 年消除乙型病毒性肝炎目标的现状和障碍:范围界定审查
source_body_en: This project registers a scoping review examining progress toward the World Health Organization (WHO) goal of eliminating viral hepatitis B (HBV) as a public health threat by 2030. In 2016, the WHO set targets of a 90% reduction in new chronic infections and a 65% reduction in mortality relative to a 2015 baseline; yet, despite effective vaccines and potent antivirals, viral hepatitis mortality continues to rise. The review assesses the global and regional status of, and impediments to, the 2030 HBV elimination goal, and compares HBV with hepatitis C virus (HCV) elimination trajectories. It was conducted following the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) methodology and reported in accordance with the PRISMA extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR). Peer-reviewed literature, global and regional surveillance reports, and grey literature published between 2015 and 2025 were searched across five databases and multiple institutional repositories, using the JBI Population–Concept–Context (PCC) framework. Charted data were mapped against WHO impact indicators (incidence, mortality, prevalence) and service-coverage indicators (HepB3 and timely birth-dose vaccination, diagnosis, treatment) across the six WHO regions. The specific objectives are: (i) to determine the global and regional status against the WHO 2030 HBV elimination targets; (ii) to evaluate the effectiveness, implementation, and gaps of HBV vaccination strategies (HepB3 and birth dose) and their impact on HBV epidemiology; and (iii) to compare HBV and HCV elimination efforts to identify divergent challenges and transferable opportunities.

title: Liver cirrhosis in Bangladesh: a systematic review of etiology, complications and management gaps
abstract: Liver cirrhosis represents a significant and growing cause of morbidity and mortality in Bangladesh, reflecting the increasing burden of chronic liver diseases in low- and middle-income countries. This systematic review aims to evaluate the current etiological patterns of cirrhosis in Bangladesh, summarize its major complications and clinical outcomes, and identify critical gaps in prevention and management. A comprehensive literature search was conducted across MEDLINE/PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, Google Scholar, and BanglaJOL from database inception to August 29, 2025. Eligible studies included observational studies, clinical trials, and national reports involving Bangladeshi populations with chronic liver disease or cirrhosis. Study selection, data extraction, and quality assessment followed PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Due to substantial methodological heterogeneity, findings were synthesized narratively. Of 1,847 identified records, 62 studies met eligibility criteria. Most were single-center hospital-based cross-sectional studies from tertiary centers in Dhaka. Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains the predominant etiology, accounting for 30-60% of cirrhosis cases, while hepatitis C virus (HCV) contributes 5-20%. Recent meta-analyses indicate a pooled HBV prevalence of 4.0% (95% CI: 3.0-5.1%) in the general population. Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD/MASLD) has emerged as a rapidly increasing cause, with community prevalence of 25-35% among adults, rising to over 50% in individuals with metabolic risk factors. Major health system challenges include inadequate HBV/HCV screening, limited access to endoscopy and liver transplantation, insufficient hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) surveillance, and absence of structured NAFLD/MASLD management pathways. Bangladesh is experiencing an epidemiological transition from viral to metabolic causes of cirrhosis, necessitating strengthened viral hepatitis control, expanded metabolic disease prevention, improved specialist services, and establishment of standardized national surveillance programs.
journal: International Journal of Research in Medical Sciences

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review addresses the growing burden of liver cirrhosis in Bangladesh, focusing on its etiology, complications, and management gaps. The study highlights the predominance of hepatitis B virus (HBV) as the main cause, contributing 30-60% of cirrhosis cases, with hepatitis C virus (HCV) accounting for 5-20%. The review identifies critical challenges in the healthcare system, including inadequate screening for HBV and HCV, limited access to specialist services, and insufficient surveillance for hepatocellular carcinoma. The findings emphasize the need for improved control of viral hepatitis and expanded prevention strategies for metabolic causes. However, the study's limitations include methodological heterogeneity, which led to narrative synthesis of results. The evidence suggests a transition from viral to metabolic causes of cirrhosis, underscoring the importance of targeted interventions and standardized surveillance programs.

title_zh: 孟加拉国肝硬化:病因学、并发症和管理差距的系统评价
source_body_en: Liver cirrhosis represents a significant and growing cause of morbidity and mortality in Bangladesh, reflecting the increasing burden of chronic liver diseases in low- and middle-income countries. This systematic review aims to evaluate the current etiological patterns of cirrhosis in Bangladesh, summarize its major complications and clinical outcomes, and identify critical gaps in prevention and management. A comprehensive literature search was conducted across MEDLINE/PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, Google Scholar, and BanglaJOL from database inception to August 29, 2025. Eligible studies included observational studies, clinical trials, and national reports involving Bangladeshi populations with chronic liver disease or cirrhosis. Study selection, data extraction, and quality assessment followed PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Due to substantial methodological heterogeneity, findings were synthesized narratively. Of 1,847 identified records, 62 studies met eligibility criteria. Most were single-center hospital-based cross-sectional studies from tertiary centers in Dhaka. Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains the predominant etiology, accounting for 30-60% of cirrhosis cases, while hepatitis C virus (HCV) contributes 5-20%. Recent meta-analyses indicate a pooled HBV prevalence of 4.0% (95% CI: 3.0-5.1%) in the general population. Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD/MASLD) has emerged as a rapidly increasing cause, with community prevalence of 25-35% among adults, rising to over 50% in individuals with metabolic risk factors. Major health system challenges include inadequate HBV/HCV screening, limited access to endoscopy and liver transplantation, insufficient hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) surveillance, and absence of structured NAFLD/MASLD management pathways. Bangladesh is experiencing an epidemiological transition from viral to metabolic causes of cirrhosis, necessitating strengthened viral hepatitis control, expanded metabolic disease prevention, improved specialist services, and establishment of standardized national surveillance programs.
abstract_zh: 肝硬化是孟加拉国发病率和 死亡率 的一个重要且日益严重的原因,反映出低收入和中等收入国家慢性肝病负担日益增加。本系统综述旨在评估孟加拉国目前肝硬化的病因模式,总结其主要并发症和临床结果,并确定预防和管理方面的关键差距。从数据库建立到 2025 年 8 月 29 日,在 MEDLINE/PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science、Google Scholar 和 BanglaJOL 上进行了全面的文献检索。符合条件的研究包括涉及患有慢性肝病或肝硬化的孟加拉国人群的观察性研究、临床试验和国家报告。研究选择、数据提取和质量评估遵循 PRISMA 2020 指南。由于方法论上存在很大的异质性,研究结果以叙述方式综合。在 1,847 项已识别记录中,62 项研究符合资格标准。大多数是来自达卡三级中心的单中心医院横断面研究。乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 仍然是主要病因,占肝硬化病例的 30-60%,而丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 占 5-20%。最近的荟萃分析表明,普通人群中的 HBV 患病率 合并率为 4.0%(95% CI:3.0-5.1%)。非酒精性脂肪肝 (NAFLD/MASLD) 已成为一个迅速增加的病因,成人中 患病率 的比例为 25-35%,在具有代谢危险因素的个体中上升至 50% 以上。卫生系统面临的主要挑战包括 HBV/HCV 筛查不足、内窥镜检查和肝移植的机会有限、肝细胞癌 (HCC) 监测 不足以及缺乏结构化的 NAFLD/MASLD 管理途径。孟加拉国正在经历肝硬化从病毒性病因到代谢性病因的流行病学转变,因此需要加强病毒性肝炎控制、扩大代谢性疾病预防、改善专家服务以及建立标准化国家 监测 规划。

title: Functional FOXA2 3’UTR variant rs1055080 is associated with HBV-related hepatocellular carcinoma risk and postoperative prognosis
abstract: Hepatocarcinogenesis is predominantly driven by chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection. Although the transcription factor FOXA2 is known to regulate hepatic development and metabolism, the impact of its genetic predisposition on HBV-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HBV-HCC) remains unclear. We performed a case-control analysis in 4,921 Chinese participants. Two candidate functional single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) (rs1209523 at the promoter region and rs1055080 at the 3’UTR region) in FOXA2 were genotyped. The functions of FOXA2 SNPs were evaluated by dual-luciferase reporter assays. The prognostic values of FOXA2 SNPs were evaluated in a postoperative cohort study of 367 patients with HBV-HCC. The frequency of the rs1055080-T allele was significantly associated with reduced risk of HBV-HCC. This association was evident when HBV-HCC patients were compared with asymptomatic HBV carriers and patients with chronic hepatitis B. In reporter assays, rs1055080-T showed higher FOXA2 3’UTR reporter activity than rs1055080-C. Reporter constructs carrying the rs1055080-C allele showed stronger repression by miR-328-3p or miR-3615 than those carrying rs1055080-T. rs1055080-T was significantly associated with lower frequencies of HCC-risk HBV mutations. Reporter activity of the rs1055080-C construct decreased in the presence of A1762T/G1764A. rs1055080-CT + TT was associated with better overall survival in HBV-HCC. These findings suggest that the FOXA2 3’UTR variant is a candidate germline marker for risk stratification and prognostic assessment in HBV-infected subjects.

title: Characterising Hepatitis D Virus in the UK From 2011 to 2021.
abstract: Little is known about hepatitis B virus (HBV) and Hepatitis D virus (HDV) coinfection in the UK. HDV screening is recommended among all individuals with HBV, with coinfection associated with increased disease progression. Using data on HDV testing, shared by 11 laboratories in the UK who reported undertaking HDV testing, and national testing data for HBV we established a cohort of individuals tested for HDV, investigating testing pathways, describing characteristics and outcomes of those HDV-RNA positive to inform targeted interventions for testing, diagnosis and linkage to care. Demographic information, clinical assessments, treatment and recent laboratory results from NHS trusts, and through linkage to national healthcare datasets was collected for HDV-RNA positive individuals. Between 2011 and 2021, 42% of individuals newly diagnosed with HBV in England were linked to an HDV test. Anti-HDV positivity was 5.0%, 55.8% were HDV-RNA tested and 45.7% were ever HDV-RNA positive. HDV-RNA positivity in the absence of an anti-HDV result was 6.4%. Among individuals who were HDV-RNA positive, 94.3% were non-UK born, with 24 different primary languages reported, 49% had evidence of treatment, and 48% had evidence of cirrhosis. 10% had died of which 58.4% died of liver disease. In conclusion, our findings indicate that HDV testing in HBV positive individuals in the UK is sub-optimal against testing guidelines, including RNA testing among those who are anti-HDV positive. Considerable work is needed to improve the patient care pathway, to ensure patients are appropriately diagnosed, linked and retained in care, with adequate access to treatment.

title: Hepatitis B surface antigen directly alters Dendritic cell-mediated Natural Killer cell responses.
abstract: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Hepatitis B, caused by the Hepatitis B virus (HBV), is a significant global health concern, often leading to chronic hepatitis B in individuals unable to mount an effective immune response. Chronic HBV substantially increases the risk of severe liver diseases, including cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. Dendritic cells (DC) and Natural killer (NK) cells play crucial roles in the early immune response to HBV, but their function is compromised in chronic hepatitis B patients. We investigated how Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) influences the interplay between DC subpopulations and NK cells. METHODS: Blood-derived DC subsets were pre-exposed to HBsAg and then co-cultured with NK cells under various stimulation conditions. We subsequently evaluated the modulations of DC, and the phenotypic and functional responses of NK cells. Similarly, DC subsets were exposed to serum from HBV-infected individuals with varying levels of HBsAg or directly purified from HBV patients to assess their ability to stimulate NK cell responses. RESULTS: Our findings show that HBsAg disrupts cDC2-mediated NK cell activation through Toll-like receptor (TLR)7/8-dependent pathways and cDC1-mediated NK cell degranulation via TLR3-dependent mechanisms. Exposure of pDC to HBsAg alters NK cell activation, phenotype and degranulation through TLR9-dependent pathways. This impairment was recapitulated following exposure to serum from HBV-infected patients in an HBsAg-dependent manner. Consistently, circulating HBsAg in patients with chronic HBV infection was associated with impaired pDC-mediated NK cell cytotoxicity. CONCLUSIONS: These results uncover key mechanisms by which HBsAg modulates pDC-NK cell interactions, shedding light on how HBV evades innate immune responses and contributes to immune dysfunction.
journal: Cellular and molecular gastroenterology and hepatology

Exposure of pDC to HBsAg alters NK cell activation, phenotype and degranulation through TLR9-dependent pathways. This impairment was recapitulated following exposure to serum from HBV-infected patients in an HBsAg-dependent manner. Consistently, circulating HBsAg in patients with chronic HBV infection was associated with impaired pDC-mediated NK cell cytotoxicity. CONCLUSIONS: These results uncover key mechanisms by which HBsAg modulates pDC-NK cell interactions, shedding light on how HBV evades innate immune responses and contributes to immune dysfunction.

source_body_en: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Hepatitis B, caused by the Hepatitis B virus (HBV), is a significant global health concern, often leading to chronic hepatitis B in individuals unable to mount an effective immune response. Chronic HBV substantially increases the risk of severe liver diseases, including cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. Dendritic cells (DC) and Natural killer (NK) cells play crucial roles in the early immune response to HBV, but their function is compromised in chronic hepatitis B patients. We investigated how Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) influences the interplay between DC subpopulations and NK cells. METHODS: Blood-derived DC subsets were pre-exposed to HBsAg and then co-cultured with NK cells under various stimulation conditions. We subsequently evaluated the modulations of DC, and the phenotypic and functional responses of NK cells. Similarly, DC subsets were exposed to serum from HBV-infected individuals with varying levels of HBsAg or directly purified from HBV patients to assess their ability to stimulate NK cell responses. RESULTS: Our findings show that HBsAg disrupts cDC2-mediated NK cell activation through Toll-like receptor (TLR)7/8-dependent pathways and cDC1-mediated NK cell degranulation via TLR3-dependent mechanisms. Exposure of pDC to HBsAg alters NK cell activation, phenotype and degranulation through TLR9-dependent pathways. This impairment was recapitulated following exposure to serum from HBV-infected patients in an HBsAg-dependent manner. Consistently, circulating HBsAg in patients with chronic HBV infection was associated with impaired pDC-mediated NK cell cytotoxicity. CONCLUSIONS: These results uncover key mechanisms by which HBsAg modulates pDC-NK cell interactions, shedding light on how HBV evades innate immune responses and contributes to immune dysfunction.

title: Examining Structural and Social Drivers of Hepatitis B Vaccination Across Diverse Clinical Settings
abstract: Abstract Background Hepatitis B is a major cause of liver cancer in the United States and is also associated with increased risks of non-Hodgkin lymphoma, pancreatic, bile duct, and head and neck cancers. Although the Hepatitis B vaccine is highly effective at preventing chronic infection and subsequent cancer development, vaccination rates remain low: In 2021, Hepatitis B vaccination coverage was 34.2% among adults 19 and older. This study evaluates Hepatitis B vaccination series completion among adolescents and young adults across clinic settings, demographics, and social determinants of health (SDOH) to identify gaps in vaccine coverage and reduce the incidence of Hepatitis B infection and related cancers. Methods We performed a retrospective, cross-sectional analysis using electronic health record data from adolescent medicine, pediatric infectious diseases, internal medicine-pediatrics, and family medicine clinics within the University of South Florida health system, and Ybor Youth Clinic, a community sexual health clinic within the USF pediatrics department. The sample included 456 patients aged 16-24 who were seen between January and March 2025 and had documented immunization histories. Completion of the Hepatitis B vaccination series was analyzed by clinic type and demographic and SDOH variables, including age, gender, race, ethnicity, insurance status, primary language, primary care provider, HPV and tetanus vaccination status, and comorbid conditions. Results Across 20 clinics, 422 patients (92.5%) completed the Hepatitis B vaccination series. Completion rates varied significantly across clinic types (p=0.012). Demographic factors such as gender, race, and ethnicity were not significantly associated with vaccination status (p=0.092, p=0.787, p=0.956). However, younger patients were more likely to have completed the vaccine series (p<0.001). Uninsured patients demonstrated lower completion rates compared to those with public or private insurance (p=0.045). Completion of other routine vaccines (HPV series, tetanus, and tetanus booster) was strongly correlated with Hepatitis B vaccination completion (all p<0.001). Having a primary care provider was not significantly linked to completion (p=0.271), and comorbidities such as HIV infection showed no significant association (p=0.092, p=0.124). Conclusion Hepatitis B vaccination rates in this cohort were substantially higher than national averages. However, disparities persisted based on various SDOH factors. Structural and access-related factors, particularly clinic type and insurance coverage, were more predictive of vaccine completion than demographic characteristics, suggesting structural factors have a greater influence than patient attributes in determining vaccination status. These findings highlight the need for system-level interventions to support series completion, particularly among underserved populations, to support Hepatitis B prevention and mitigate cancer-related disparities.
journal: Journal of the Pediatric Infectious Diseases Society

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨不同临床环境中乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 的结构和社会驱动因素,解决 疫苗接种 发病率低的公共卫生问题,尽管 疫苗 可有效预防慢性感染和相关癌症。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用南佛罗里达大学卫生系统内 20 个诊所的电子健康记录数据进行了回顾性横断面分析,这些诊所包括青少年医学、儿科传染病和社区性健康诊所。该研究纳入了 456 名年龄在 16 岁至 24 岁之间、有免疫史且在 2025 年 1 月至 3 月期间就诊的患者。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究按诊所类型以及人口统计和健康社会决定因素 (SDOH) 变量分析了乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 系列的完成情况,包括年龄、性别、种族、民族、保险状况、主要语言、初级保健提供者、HPV 和破伤风 疫苗接种 状态以及合并症。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 20 个诊所中,422 名患者 (92.5%) 完成了乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 系列。不同诊所类型的完成率差异很大 (p=0.012)。年轻患者更有可能完成 疫苗 系列 (p<0.001)。与拥有公共或私人保险的患者相比,未参保患者的完成率较低 (p=0.045)。其他常规 疫苗(HPV 系列、破伤风和破伤风加强疫苗)的完成与乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 的完成密切相关(所有 p<0.001)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,结构和访问相关因素,特别是诊所类型和保险范围,比人口特征更能预测 疫苗 的完成情况,表明结构因素对 疫苗接种 状态的影响比患者属性更大。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调需要采取系统级干预措施来支持乙型肝炎系列的完成,特别是在服务不足的人群中,以加强预防工作并减少与癌症相关的差异。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其对电子健康记录数据的依赖而受到限制,这可能会引入偏差或缺失信息。由于该研究的观察性质以及存在未测量的混杂因素的可能性,证据强度适中。

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 在美国,乙型肝炎是肝癌的主要原因,并且还与非霍奇金淋巴瘤、胰腺癌、胆管癌和头颈癌的风险增加有关。尽管乙型肝炎 疫苗 在预防慢性感染和随后的癌症发展方面非常有效,但 疫苗接种 比率仍然很低:2021 年,乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 在 19 岁及以上成年人中的覆盖率为 34.2%。本研究评估青少年和年轻人在临床环境、人口统计和健康社会决定因素 (SDOH) 方面的乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 系列完成情况,以确定 疫苗 覆盖范围的差距,并减少乙型肝炎感染和相关癌症的 发病率。方法 我们使用来自南佛罗里达大学卫生系统内的青少年医学、儿科传染病、内科儿科和家庭医学诊所以及南佛罗里达大学儿科内的社区性健康诊所 Ybor Youth Clinic 的电子健康记录数据进行了回顾性横断面分析。该样本包括 456 名年龄在 16-24 岁之间的患者,他们在 2025 年 1 月至 3 月期间就诊,并有记录的免疫史。乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 系列的完成情况通过诊所类型、人口统计和 SDOH 变量进行分析,包括年龄、性别、种族、民族、保险状况、主要语言、初级保健提供者、HPV 和破伤风 疫苗接种 状态以及合并症。结果 20 个诊所中,422 名患者 (92.5%) 完成了乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 系列。不同诊所类型的完成率差异很大 (p=0.012)。性别、种族和族裔等人口统计因素与 疫苗接种 状态没有显着相关性 (p=0.092、p=0.787、p=0.956)。然而,年轻患者更有可能完成 疫苗 系列 (p<0.001)。与拥有公共或私人保险的患者相比,未参保的患者的完成率较低 (p=0.045)。其他常规 疫苗(HPV 系列、破伤风和破伤风加强疫苗)的完成与乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 的完成密切相关(所有 p<0.001)。拥有初级保健提供者与完成治疗没有显着相关性(p=0.271),并且 HIV 感染等合并症也没有显示出显着关联(p=0.092,p=0.124)。结论 本次队列研究中乙型肝炎疫苗接种发病率明显高于全国平均水平。然而,由于各种 SDOH 因素,差异仍然存在。结构性和访问相关因素,特别是诊所类型和保险覆盖范围,比人口统计特征更能预测 疫苗 的完成情况,这表明结构性因素在确定 疫苗 状态方面比患者属性具有更大的影响力。这些发现强调需要采取系统级干预措施来支持系列的完成,特别是在服务不足的人群中,以支持乙型肝炎预防并减轻与癌症相关的差异。

title: Trends and forecasting of reported hepatitis B and hepatitis C incidence in Hainan Province, China, 2005–2020
abstract: Objective To assess long-term trends, seasonality, forecasts, and ecological associations with tourist visits for reported hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) incidence in Hainan Province from 2005 to 2020. Methods Reported HBV and HCV incidence data from Hainan, national Global Burden of Disease (GBD) estimates for China, and annual tourist visit data were analyzed. Joinpoint regression assessed temporal trends, seasonal-trend decomposition using loess evaluated monthly variation, and seasonal autoregressive integrated moving average models generated forecasts. Spearman rank correlation analysis examined tourism associations, with sensitivity analyses excluding 2020 and using first-differenced and linearly detrended series. Results Reported HBV incidence declined from 2005 to 2008, increased from 2008 to 2018, and then showed a non-significant decline through 2020; the overall average annual percent change (AAPC) was +3.37%. Reported HCV incidence increased until 2015 and subsequently declined, with an overall AAPC of +14.54%. National GBD estimates showed overall AAPCs of −0.54% for HBV and −1.52% for HCV. No significant differences among calendar months were detected. Under continuation of historical reporting patterns, the annualized projected reported HBV incidence in 2030 was 12.00 per 100,000 population (95% prediction interval: approximately 0.00–121.20), numerically close to the study-defined reference value of 12.20. The corresponding HCV estimate was 22.54 per 100,000 population (approximately 0.00–39.10), approximately 6.4 times the study-defined reference value of 3.55. The wide prediction intervals indicated substantial long-term forecast uncertainty. In 2020, observed mean monthly reported HBV and HCV incidence rates were 27.3% and 9.5% lower than forecasted values, respectively. In raw annual analyses, tourist visits correlated with reported HBV and HCV incidence (r = 0.871 and 0.879; both P < 0.001). After first differencing and linear detrending, the association remained significant only for reported HBV incidence. Conclusion Reported HBV and HCV incidence in Hainan showed distinct phased changes without significant monthly differences. The forecasts represent projections under historical reporting patterns and should not be interpreted as evidence of progress toward WHO elimination targets. Tourism associations were exploratory and ecological and do not support causal inference. Continued surveillance and strengthened HCV screening, diagnosis, and linkage to treatment remain important.

title: Seroepidemiological Characteristics and Influencing Factors of Hepatitis B Virus Infection Among Pregnant Women in Nanning City, China (2024–2025): A Cross-Sectional Study
abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major public health concern among pregnant women, with regional disparities in epidemic characteristics that hinder precise prevention of mother-to-child transmission (MTCT). This study aimed to characterize the seroepidemiological profiles of HBV infection and identify its associated influencing factors among pregnant women in Nanning City, providing evidence-based insights for optimizing targeted interventions to block HBV MTCT. A stratified cluster random sampling strategy was adopted to recruit pregnant women receiving routine antenatal care at designated medical institutions across Nanning between October 2024 and May 2025. Standardized face-to-face questionnaires were administered to collect demographic, behavioral, and disease-related data. Venous blood samples were collected for quantitative detection of five serological HBV markers via chemiluminescence immunoassay. The Kruskal–Wallis test was used to compare the geometric mean concentration (GMC) of hepatitis B surface antibody (HBsAb), while the chi-square test was applied to analyze intergroup differences in the seropositivity rates of the five HBV markers. Multivariate unconditional logistic regression models were constructed to explore factors independently associated with seropositivity of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), HBsAb, and hepatitis B core antibody (HBcAb). A total of 1,935 eligible pregnant women were enrolled. The overall seropositivity rates of HBsAg, HBsAb, hepatitis B e-antigen (HBeAg), hepatitis e-antibody (HBeAb), and HBcAb were 6.98%, 59.48%, 1.50%, 15.50%, and 33.02%, respectively. Seropositivity of HBsAg, HBsAb, HBeAb, and HBcAb exhibited an age-dependent ascending trend, with the lowest rates observed in the 14–19 age group and peak rates in the 40–49 age group. Rural residents presented significantly higher HBsAg and HBeAb seropositivity but lower HBsAb seropositivity compared with urban counterparts. Participants with unknown or no prior HBV vaccination history showed markedly higher seropositivity of HBsAg, HBeAg, HBeAb, and HBcAb, alongside reduced HBsAb positivity, relative to those vaccinated within the past 5 years or ≥5 years prior (all P < 0.001). Furthermore, individuals vaccinated ≥5 years ago demonstrated higher HBV marker seropositivity and lower HBsAb positivity than those vaccinated within 5 years (all P < 0.001). Multivariate logistic regression revealed that advanced maternal age, rural residency, comorbid chronic underlying diseases, and close contact with HBV carriers/patients were independent risk factors for HBsAg seropositivity, whereas prior HBV vaccination exerted a protective effect. Advanced age, higher educational attainment, and HBV vaccination history independently predicted higher odds of HBsAb positivity; rural residency, chronic comorbidities, and non-medical occupational status were risk factors for insufficient HBsAb seroconversion. For HBcAb seropositivity, advanced age, chronic underlying diseases, and exposure to HBV-infected individuals were independent risk factors, while higher education and vaccination history served as protective factors. The study addressed the knowledge gap regarding seroepidemiological profiles and influencing factors of HBV infection in this population to inform targeted interventions.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study recruited 1,935 pregnant women receiving routine antenatal care in Nanning City between October 2024 and May 2025 using stratified cluster random sampling across designated medical institutions.
analysis.methods: Standardized questionnaires collected demographic, behavioral, and disease-related data. Venous blood samples were analyzed for five HBV serological markers (HBsAg, HBsAb, HBeAg, HBeAb, HBcAb) via chemiluminescence immunoassay. Multivariate unconditional logistic regression models identified factors independently associated with seropositivity of HBsAg, HBsAb, and HBcAb.
analysis.main_results: The overall seropositivity rates were 6.98% for HBsAg, 59.48% for HBsAb, 1.50% for HBeAg, 15.50% for HBeAb, and 33.02% for HBcAb. Seropositivity of HBsAg, HBsAb, HBeAb, and HBcAb increased with age, peaking in the 40–49 age group. Rural residents had higher HBsAg and HBeAb seropositivity but lower HBsAb seropositivity than urban residents.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study identified advanced maternal age, rural residency, chronic comorbidities, and close contact with HBV carriers as independent risk factors for HBsAg seropositivity, while prior HBV vaccination was protective. Novelty lies in quantifying urban–rural disparities and waning vaccine-induced immunity over time in this population.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Findings highlight the need for targeted HBV vaccination strategies, including booster doses for childbearing-age women with insufficient HBsAb levels, to reduce incident infections and mitigate vertical transmission risk in Nanning City.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 传播 (HBV) 感染对孕妇构成持续的公共卫生挑战,区域差异使预防母婴 传播 (MTCT) 的工作变得更加复杂。该研究解决了有关该人群乙型肝炎病毒感染的血清流行病学概况和影响因素的知识差距,为有针对性的干预措施提供信息。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项横断面研究采用分层整群随机抽样方法,在定点医疗机构中招募了2024年10月至2025年5月期间在南宁市接受常规产前检查的1,935名孕妇。
elements_zh.methods: 标准化问卷收集人口、行为和疾病相关数据。通过化学发光免疫分析对静脉血样本进行五种 HBV 血清学标志物(HBsAg、HBsAb、HBeAg、HBeAb、HBcAb)分析。多变量无条件逻辑回归模型确定了与 HBsAg、HBsAb 和 HBcAb 血清阳性独立相关的因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 总体血清阳性率为 HBsAg 6.98%、HBsAb 59.48%、HBeAg 1.50%、HBeAb 15.50% 和 HBcAb 33.02%。HBsAg、HBsAb、HBeAb 和 HBcAb 的血清阳性率随着年龄的增长而增加,在 40-49 岁年龄组达到峰值。农村居民的HBsAg和HBeAb血清阳性率高于城市居民,但HBsAb血清阳性率低于城市居民。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究确定高龄产妇、农村居民、慢性合并症以及与 HBV 携带者的密切接触是 HBsAg 血清阳性的独立危险因素,而既往 HBV 疫苗接种 具有保护作用。新颖之处在于量化城乡差异以及 疫苗 引起的免疫力随着时间的推移而减弱。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调,南宁市需要有针对性的 HBV 传播 策略,包括对 HBsAb 水平不足的育龄妇女进行加强剂量,以减少感染事件并减轻垂直 传播 风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 横截面设计限制了因果推断,并且对自我报告的 疫苗接种 历史的依赖可能会引入回忆偏差。尽管存在这些限制,但大样本量和多变量调整增强了识别风险因素的证据基础。
